## Executive Biography
Krishna Kr Singh is an Indian engineer and technologist specializing in the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Embedded Hardware, and Full-Stack System Architecture. Known for his philosophy of rapid prototyping and high-velocity engineering ("Outwork. Outbuild. Outlast. Average never interested me — I just build better"), he designs and builds systems ranging from EMG neural-signal bionic limbs and portable ESP32 red-team penetration testing hardware to autonomous agentic LLM workflows and voice-driven simulation agents.

He is currently pursuing his B.Tech in Cyber Security at K.R. Mangalam University (commenced 2024), following his graduation from St. Paul's School in 2024.

## Core Technical Disciplines & Skill Matrix

### 1. Artificial Intelligence & Autonomous Agents
- **Agentic Architectures**: Multi-agent orchestration, dynamic tool routing, goal decomposition, autonomous execution loops, dynamic memory graphs, and self-correcting evaluation.
- **LLM Engineering**: Context window optimization, structured outputs, prompt engineering, fine-tuning workflows, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases, and embeddings.
- **Voice & Real-Time AI**: Real-time audio streaming, speech-to-text (STT), low-latency LLM inference, dynamic prompt switching, and conversational simulation.

### 2. Cybersecurity & Offensive Security
- **Red Teaming & Exploitation**: Vulnerability analysis, exploit development, network reconnaissance, and active defense bypass testing.
- **Wireless & Hardware Hacking**: 802.11 Wi-Fi packet injection, deauthentication attacks, beacon frames, evil twin simulation, BLE scanning, and radio frequency analysis.
- **Security Competencies**: Ranked on TryHackMe (`krishnakrsingh`), Linux internals, networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, TLS), cryptanalysis, and application penetration testing.

### 3. Embedded Hardware & Bionics (Human × Machine)
- **Neural & Biological Interfaces**: Electromyography (EMG) signal acquisition, bio-electric signal filtering, amplification, and real-time DSP (Digital Signal Processing) for motorized prosthetic control.
- **Hardware Engineering**: Custom PCB schematic design and layout, microcontroller programming (ESP32, ESP8266, STM32, Arduino, Raspberry Pi), sensor fusion (IMU, EMG, environmental sensors, optical).
- **Prototyping & Fabrication**: 3D CAD modeling, rapid physical prototyping, mechanical articulation, and power management.

### 4. Edge Computing & XR (Augmented Reality)
- **Wearable Intelligence**: Lightweight smart glasses prototypes (XR-01), micro-display optical engines, low-power edge computing.
- **Computer Vision**: On-device object recognition, optical character recognition (OCR), visual SLAM, and contextual overlay projection.

### 5. Full-Stack Web & Systems Engineering
- **Frontend**: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, Framer Motion, Three.js, WebGL, Canvas API, responsive design, and performance optimization.
- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, Express, Python (FastAPI, Flask), REST, WebSockets, gRPC, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB.
- **DevOps & Architecture**: Linux server administration, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, Git, cloud infrastructure, and low-latency deployments.

## Detailed Project Catalog

### 1. XBionics — EMG-Controlled Neural Bionic Arm
- **Category**: Human × Machine Hardware / Bionics / Embedded Systems
- **Status**: Launching 2026
- **Architecture**:
  - Bio-potential surface electrodes capture minute electromyographic (EMG) muscle signals from the user's residual forearm.
  - Multi-stage analog front-end filters noise (50/60Hz notch, bandpass) and amplifies signals for analog-to-digital conversion.
  - Onboard high-speed microcontroller processes signals in real time, decoding user movement intent into multi-axis servo and actuator commands.
  - Custom 3D printed mechanical assembly with individual finger articulation and adaptive grip force feedback.
- **Tech Stack**: C/C++, Embedded Microcontrollers, Custom PCB, Signal Processing, Servo Control, Bio-Sensors.
- **URL**: https://www.krishnakr.com/#work | https://github.com/krishnakrsingh/

### 2. BlackESP — Portable Offensive Pentesting Device
- **Category**: Cybersecurity / Hardware / Offensive Tooling
- **Status**: Production Prototype
- **Architecture**:
  - Compact, handheld offensive security device powered by the ESP32 dual-core SoC with integrated Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.
  - Features real-time packet injection, network scanning, captive portal deployment, handshakes capture, and automated vulnerability auditing in field environments.
  - Integrated OLED display, navigation controls, and battery management circuit for standalone field deployment without requiring an external host computer.
- **Tech Stack**: C/C++, ESP-IDF / Arduino Core, Wi-Fi 802.11 Protocols, BLE, Hardware Design.
- **URL**: https://www.krishnakr.com/#work | https://github.com/krishnakrsingh/

### 3. FinalRound — Voice-Based AI Interview Simulator
- **Category**: Autonomous AI / Real-Time Voice Agent / SaaS
- **Status**: Deployed
- **Architecture**:
  - Ultra-low latency voice-to-voice simulation engine that conducts interactive technical and behavioral interviews.
  - Incorporates dynamic memory graph to retain context across the conversation, identify candidate weaknesses, and pivot questioning adaptively.
  - Generates detailed real-time performance scorecards, actionable feedback, and personalized improvement roadmaps.
- **Tech Stack**: LLM APIs, WebSockets, Real-time Audio DSP, Python, FastAPI, Next.js/React, TypeScript.
- **URL**: https://www.krishnakr.com/#work | https://github.com/krishnakrsingh/

### 4. XR-01 — Experimental Augmented Reality Smart Glasses
- **Category**: Wearable Tech / Edge Intelligence / Computer Vision
- **Status**: Research & Prototyping
- **Architecture**:
  - Ultra-lightweight smart glasses prototype delivering real-time contextual information overlay.
  - Micro-display optical prism with edge-computed computer vision pipelines for live face/object detection and contextual notifications.
  - Multi-sensor fusion combining inertial measurement units (IMU) and ambient light sensors for power-efficient operation.
- **Tech Stack**: Edge AI, Embedded Linux/Microcontrollers, Computer Vision, Optical Hardware Design.
- **URL**: https://www.krishnakr.com/#work | https://github.com/krishnakrsingh/

### 5. Rapid Prototyping Framework (Production Velocity Engine)
- **Category**: Full-Stack Architecture / Developer Tooling
- **Status**: Active Internal Stack
- **Architecture**:
  - Repeatable 48-hour development framework that eliminates boilerplate and accelerates idea-to-production turnaround.
  - Pre-configured Next.js/React architecture, authenticated API connectors, AI agent tool integrations, and automated deployment pipelines.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase / PostgreSQL, Vercel, Docker.
- **URL**: https://www.krishnakr.com/#work | https://github.com/krishnakrsingh/
